main.summary: Describes server-authoritative integrity for ordered verified transfer content.

property.name: Digest
property.summary: Digest of the ordered verified content-segment metadata.

property.name: SegmentCount
property.summary: Number of verified content segments used to compute the digest.

method.name: Validate
method.returns: True when the integrity record is valid.

main.summary: Describes one verified content segment used by the canonical integrity digest.
Computes the server-authoritative ordered content integrity digest.

field.name: LeafDomain
field.summary: Domain-separation prefix used when hashing an individual verified segment.

field.name: NodeDomain
field.summary: Domain-separation prefix used when hashing an internal integrity-tree node.

field.name: EmptyDomain
field.summary: Domain-separation prefix used when hashing content with no verified segments.

method.name: Compute
method.summary: Computes integrity from ordered verified segment metadata.
method.param: Verified content segments to include in the integrity calculation.

method.name: ComputeRoot
method.summary: Computes the root digest for a collection of segment or tree-node digests.
method.returns: Root digest for the supplied nodes.
